Veel mensen zien het gemak van een verhu: Many people appreciate the convenience of a moving lift: you have to walk up and down stairs much less often. Everything also goes faster. But not every removal needs a moving lift. For addresses such as a flat or a high apartment, it's very handy to work with a moving lift, and large, heavy items that often can't fit through the house also require a lift.
In dit soort gevallen komen verhuislifte: In these kinds of cases, moving lifts come in very handy. This way you don't have to carry heavy items up and down stairs, and you avoid awkward situations with narrow stairwells, sharp stair bends or narrow doorways. On top of that, the removal will go a lot faster and more safely when a moving lift is used.
Bij de Bresser beschikken wij over een v: At De Bresser we have a moving lift mounted on a vehicle. Our movers also use Geda lifts. They assemble these on site and take them apart again afterwards. The Geda version is often used for somewhat smaller items. The advisor who comes to take stock checks how many m³ will be moving to the new home. Based on that, they also assess whether a moving lift is needed or not.
Een verhuislift brengt natuurlijk kosten: A moving lift naturally comes with costs, but on the other hand it also means the movers finish more quickly. Sometimes there's no way around using a moving lift.
